fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.body: The TV works with the SFR TV Android box: use the second remote control to turn it on and navigate. Remember to log out of your accounts before you leave.
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body: Kitchenette equipped with: hob, microwave, fridge-freezer, dishes and utensils. Note: no oven or dishwasher.
fields.amenities.2.title: Kitchen
fields.amenities.3.body: A filter coffee maker and kettle are available in the kitchen. There is no capsule machine.
fields.amenities.3.title: Coffee
fields.amenities.4.body: The heated towel rail in the bathroom sometimes has a child lock. If it won't turn on, contact us and we'll take care of it.
fields.amenities.4.title: Heating
fields.amenities.5.body: The washing machine plugs into the socket located at the top left of the bathroom mirror.
fields.amenities.5.title: Washing machine
fields.amenities.6.body: The sofa bed provides an extra sleeping space. Bedding (duvet + pillow) is stored on the shelf to the right of the sofa. It's not made up on arrival, to give you more space during the day.
fields.amenities.6.title: Sofa bed
fields.amenities.7.body: To get started — a few rolls of toilet paper and welcome essentials. For your entire stay — sheets and towels (2 towels per bed), hair dryer, and an iron stored above the kitchen in the large cupboard.
fields.amenities.7.title: What we provide
fields.amenities.8.body: The bin storage is located at the bottom of the spiral staircase. Please take out your rubbish when you leave — out of respect for our cleaning team.
fields.amenities.8.title: Bins & recycling
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.0: Did you press the padlock after entering the code? It validates your entry — without pressing it, the box won't open.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.1: The box unlocked, but did you pull to the side to open it? Unlocking doesn't open it automatically.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: After several wrong codes, the box goes into safety mode. Wait 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, then try again calmly.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.title: Having trouble opening the key box?
fields.arrival.steps.0.text: You arrive at 3 rue de la Valfenière, in the heart of the Presqu'île. From place des Terreaux, take rue Paul Chenavard then rue Major Martin (at the corner of Café des Fédérations). Coming from rue de la Plâtrière, it's at the corner of Franprix Marché Presqu'île.
fields.arrival.steps.0.title: Find the building
fields.arrival.steps.1.text: Enter the code on the front door. The same code opens both doors — the street door, then the hall door.
fields.arrival.steps.1.title: Building entry code
fields.arrival.steps.2.text: Take the spiral staircase and climb to the 3rd floor.
fields.arrival.steps.2.title: Go up to the 3rd floor
fields.arrival.steps.3.code_note: Your code · active until your departure
fields.arrival.steps.3.photo_caption: The key box, on the landing door
fields.arrival.steps.3.text: It's on the landing door, on the 3rd floor. Place your palm on the keypad to light it up, enter your code then press the padlock logo. Wait for the beep, then pull to the side to open the box and retrieve the keys.
fields.arrival.steps.3.title: The key box
fields.arrival.steps.4.text: The keys open the door. Welcome to L'Alcôve ✨
fields.arrival.steps.4.title: You're here
fields.checkout_line: bins at the bottom of the staircase, windows closed, keys in the box
fields.house_rules.0.text: No elevator, via a spiral staircase.
fields.house_rules.0.title: 3rd floor, spiral staircase
fields.house_rules.1.text: Smoking is not allowed inside. A detector will alert us — restoration costs up to €65.
fields.house_rules.1.title: Non-smoking apartment
fields.house_rules.2.text: Building with residents in the city center — please respect your neighbors' peace and quiet.
fields.house_rules.2.title: No parties or gatherings
fields.house_rules.3.text: The two large living room cupboards contain cleaning supplies — please keep them closed.
fields.house_rules.3.title: Cleaning cupboards
fields.house_rules.4.text: Please note: some guests may have allergies.
fields.house_rules.4.title: No pets
fields.house_rules.5.text: Building with residents — please be considerate of your neighbors.
fields.house_rules.5.title: Quiet after 10 PM
fields.luggage.sub_arrival: Nannybag luggage storage in Lyon · from €4.50/day
fields.luggage.sub_departure: Drop off your bags and enjoy Lyon until your train · from €4.50/day
fields.parking.summary: Pedestrian city center — underground parking nearby
fields.parking.text.0: The city center is pedestrian: surface parking is very difficult.
fields.parking.text.1: Nearest LPA underground parking: Terreaux (paid), Saint-Antoine, then Cordelier (a bit further). Multi-day and weekend packages (Friday→Monday) are often good value.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: Voted best authentic bouchon (traditional Lyonnaise restaurant) 2019-2020. Lyonnaise cuisine lunch and dinner, even on Sundays — just at the end of the street.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: A Lyonnaise gastronomy institution, warm atmosphere. Open Wednesday to Sunday.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Panoramic terrace on the 7th floor of the Opera, with views of Fourvière — 350 m away. Better in the evening.
fields.recos.food.3.desc: Rue Mercière, rue de l'Arbre-Sec, rue des Marronniers and Old Town: the heart of dining, just steps away.
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: Supermarket and fresh produce, rue de la Plâtrière — at the corner of the building.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: The nearest bakery, 100 m away, rue du Plâtre. Bread, pastries and sandwiches.
fields.recos.shop.2.desc: Quick shopping ~500 m away, towards place Croix-Paquet.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: The Bartholdi fountain and Town Hall, at the end of the street. The Fine Arts Museum overlooks the square.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: Renaissance district listed by UNESCO, ~1 km away (15 min walk or metro D). Traboules (passageways) and Saint-Jean Cathedral.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: Panoramic views over all of Lyon, ~1.2 km away. Climb through Old Town then take the funicular from Saint-Jean station.
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: Gallo-Roman museum and ancient theaters on Fourvière hill (~1.5 km). Theater access is free.
fields.recos.visit.4.desc: Spectacular architecture at the tip of the Presqu'île. Metro A → Perrache, then tram T1.
fields.recos.visit.5.desc: 5 km riverside stroll (bars, houseboats, lawns), ~15 min walk away.
fields.transport.lines.0.text: Station Hôtel de Ville — Louis Pradel. Direct line A to Bellecour, Perrache, and Part-Dieu (via line B).
fields.transport.lines.0.title: Metro A
fields.transport.lines.1.text: Stop Terreaux La Feuillée: lines C3, C13, C14, C18, 19, S6, S12, PL1.
fields.transport.lines.1.title: Bus
fields.transport.lines.2.text: Part-Dieu in 25 min (metro A then B); Perrache in 15 min (direct metro A).
fields.transport.lines.2.title: Train stations
fields.transport.lines.3.text: Rhônexpress to Vaulx-en-Velin La Soie, then metro A → Hôtel de Ville. Or bus C200, or Uber/taxi (~45 min).
fields.transport.lines.3.title: Airport
